display.purpose: Page identity and major editorial titles.

label.purpose: Module coordinates, workflow stages, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: expanded-structural-lift
shadows.purpose: Expanded navigation groups and structural containers.

motion.name: micro-state
motion.purpose: Short border, background, color, and shadow state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable non-essential transitions and rolling effects when requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confident next action using System Indigo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 8px 16px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-strong); }

components.name: Workflow Stage Rail
components.description: Numbered or checked stages show progress, current focus, and the next destination.
components.css: .workflow-stage-rail button { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--card) 88%, transparent); } .workflow-stage-rail .is-active button { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 62%, var(--border)); background: var(--primary-subtle); }

components.name: Neutral Card
components.description: Tonal container for one coherent work unit.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 16px; }

narrative.overview: An editorial, layered, and opinionated personal operating system for independent work. System Indigo signals action and state against a neutral canvas; tonal surfaces carry hierarchy while tactile controls keep frequent operations confident.

rules.name: The Signal Indigo Rule
rules.body: Use the primary indigo to communicate action, selection, progress, or focus.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Surfaces should read correctly before shadows are added.

rules.name: The Hierarchy Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Weight, size, spacing, and labels establish scanability before visual effects.

dos: Do show current state and next action in the component.
Do preserve light and dark theme contrast.
Do stack dense work areas at narrow breakpoints.
donts: Don't flatten workflows into undifferentiated cards.
Don't introduce arbitrary radii, shadows, or spacing.
Don't hide important status in hover-only affordances.
Don't trade keyboard access or touch targets for density.
